hints.title: Bottom-Left Definition
hints.text: The bottom-left value is the first value in the bottom-most level of the binary tree.

hints.title: Right-to-Left Breadth-First Traversal
hints.text: Enqueue right child before left child. The last node removed from the queue will naturally be the leftmost node of the lowest level.

hints.title: Queue Termination Invariant
hints.text: Initialize queue with root. In each iteration, pop front node, push right child if present, then left child. When queue is empty, the final dequeued node holds the desired value.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Right-to-left breadth-first traversal terminating on the bottom-left node.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Tracking depth with recursion requires comparing depths and updating globals.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Right-to-left queue order guarantees the last popped node is the target without depth checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use right-to-left BFS queue order for an elegant single-loop solution.
